## Improved

- The bottom bar now uses Material's short navigation bar, so screens above it get the same height in split screen as full screen.
- Shorts' action buttons sit on the same scrim discs as the app's, and the rail, labels, channel row and metadata line up with the reference in both window layouts.
- The Subscribe button on a Short now uses Material's compact size, so it matches the reference's height.
- The comments sheet on a Short is a flat full width panel with a drag handle and a titled header, sits above the bottom bar, and opens at the same height the reference gives it.
- While a Short's comments are open, the reel shrinks to the space above the sheet and drops its channel row, metadata and action rail, so the sheet no longer covers the video the way it used to.
- The comments sheet now rests at the height the reference gives it, in full screen and in a split pane, so its top edge, drag handle, title row and close button sit exactly where the reference's do.
- The music tab heads every shelf with the app's large emphasized title on the same 12dp inset and spacing, and its bar carries four action buttons at the bar's end, so its headings and bar now sit where the reference's do.
- The music tab now opens with the same filter chip row the reference shows, and each shelf picks the body its contents call for: dense tiles for mixes, square cards for albums and collection pages, and round portraits for artists, on the reference's own spacing.
- Subscriptions opens on the same Quick access band the reference shows, on its own 12dp inset and 4dp feed margin, with an All filter row under it, so the channel shortcuts, their labels and the chip row sit at the reference's measured positions.- Subscriptions lists its uploads as the reference's rows: a still one feed column wide, the title in the app's small title style, the channel line and the views line under it, each row 226 px tall at the reference's measured frames (rows x5-795, title x400, channel +36 and views +78 from the title top), with the bar's toggle view mode, search and profile discs landing on the reference's first, second and fourth slots.
- The accessibility dump of a phone screen no longer dies on a title that opens with an emoji: the still's monogram took one char of a surrogate pair, and the platform's XML writer refuses a string holding half of one.
- Subscriptions' parity record now closes on measured reference frames: Home's chips, big title, metadata, shelf header and shelf body measure the same at the start and the end of a run (chips y143-166, title [107,411][320,468], metadata [107,473][320,515], shelf header [64,566][249,593], shelf body [500,876][639,896]), the Subscriptions bar title measures [21,64][163,94] in the reference's idle state and on the port, so the earlier reference dump taken while a refresh ran was the reference hiding its own title and not a frame to match, and the music tab still measures its chip row [0,133][800,197], chips at x38 and x171, heading at 16,224 and cards [16,270][186,491] and [202,270][372,491]. Three reference states have no source in the port and stay documented instead of drawn: the notifications disc (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/components/layout/topbar/FlowTopBarActions.kt:44-53, `FlowNotificationsAction(unreadCount = unreadCount, onClick = actions.onOpenNotifications)` drawing `Icons.Outlined.Notifications`) at [668,48][731,111], the row's more-options button (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/components/shared/card/VideoCardRow.kt:105-110, `VideoCardSideActions(state = state, showWatched = ..., onWatched = ..., alignTo = 14.dp)`) at [748,944][780,976], and the refresh status line (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/screens/subscriptions/SubscriptionsRefreshStatus.kt:20-26, `if (totalChannels > 0) { ... LinearProgressIndicator(...) } else if (lastRefreshText != null) { Text(...) }`) at [21,378][301,396].
- The bar's notifications button now opens the app's notifications page: the empty inbox with the bell on its state card, "Peace and quiet", its body and the Notification settings button, plus the settings action in the bar, all on the reference's measured frames (icon card [337,586][465,714], title [317,730][484,757], body [78,773][723,796], button [274,812][528,876]). Home's bar now carries the notifications disc between Search and Settings, and Subscriptions' third disc opens the page instead of leaving its slot empty. The page draws the empty inbox because the port writes no notification records: the app fills them from its notification helper (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/notification/NotificationHelper.kt:113, `db.notificationDao().insertNotification(entity)`), groups them by day (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/screens/notifications/NotificationGrouping.kt:69-86) and lists them in rows that swipe to save or delete (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/screens/notifications/NotificationRow.kt:44-110), so the populated sections, their swipe actions, the clear-all dialog and its snackbars are not drawn. The music tab's bar keeps the moods shortcut in the slot the app gives the notifications disc: the app reaches moods from a shelf inside the music feed (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/components/music/section/MusicHomeFeed.kt:317-329, `HomeSectionType.MOODS_AND_GENRES` with `MusicMoodsShelf(onSeeAll = ...)`, opened at app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/MusicNavigation.kt:70), and this port's music feed does not draw that shelf, so the shortcut stays where it is until the shelf is ported. An audit of the app's navigation graph against the port's destinations finds no other page the port links to and cannot open: the app's remaining screens (recap, music recognition, equalizer, in-app update, wellbeing lock, donations and the settings sub-pages) are features the port does not implement, so no bar, sheet or row points at them.
- The music tab's bar now carries the notifications disc on the app's slot, opening the notifications page with back returning to the music tab, and moods moved to where the app keeps them: the music feed ends with the app's Mood and Genres shelf, a heading with the arrow that opens the full index over three rows of medium mood buttons in the app's tone cycle, each opening its collection, at the app's measured frames (heading text 187 px wide at the 12 dp inset with its arrow at x752-784, buttons 245 by 75 px at x16, x277 and x538 on a 91 px pitch). The moods index is rebuilt as the app's category grid: the title "Moods & Genres", each category heading on the app's 18 dp inset and its buttons in rows of the app's window-class columns at the medium button height. The music page also remembers where it was scrolled, so a page opened from a shelf or the index returns to the same place the app returns to. One gap stays open with its source: the app plans and shuffles its music section order every session (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/screens/music/EnhancedMusicScreen.kt:116-152), while the port draws the response's own order and puts the moods shelf after it.
- A mood's own page now draws its shelves the way the app's browse page does. Every shelf that is not made only of songs is a lane of square collection cards at the app's grid size, with the emphasized title eight pixels under the artwork and the byline under it, and an artist's card takes the artist's cookie shape with a centred name; a shelf made only of songs is a lane of four compact rows, segmented down each column, at the app's 360 dp column cap with 48 dp of the next column in view (app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/ui/screens/music/YouTubeBrowseScreen.kt:127-145, ui/components/music/section/MusicShelf.kt:52-138, ui/components/music/item/MusicTrackItem.kt:86-235). Measured against the app at 800 by 1340 with the focus checked on each package: the mood page header [22,64][54,96] and [74,64][118,94], heading [16,138][219,168], card artwork [16,184][186,354] at x16, 202, 388 and 574 with the fifth peeking at 760, card boxes 16,184 to 16,405, titles [16,362][177,385] and bylines [16,385][123,405], every frame identical to the app's. The compact song lane is built from the source above; the Chill page measured for this check carried no song shelf, so that one shape has not been exercised on the device. The shared card also took the app's emphasized title style, which the app gives every collection card, so the music tab's New releases cards keep their measured boxes with the heavier title inside them.
